# GKMS public Localify loader source 0.1

This is the corresponding modified Localify source for the public `version.dll`
loader candidate. Upstream: https://git.natsume.io/Mirror/gkms-localify-dmm.git, commit `098a41459e17b130be02353f26d0ab0a2ccad914`.
The source manifest records the retained audited Hook/proxy inputs, actual staged
public source hashes, exported hashes, and the compiler-input file closure.

The public loader forwards the version exports and enters the existing managed
thread bootstrap. It loads `gkms/native/gkms_runtime_command_bridge.dll` and the
normal `gkms/native/gkms_runtime_exam_recorder.dll` beside the game executable.
Runtime state goes beneath `%LOCALAPPDATA%/gkms-assistant`.

Research Headless/Leaderboard sources are excluded. Three source files are
specialized to their already-existing `GKMS_PUBLIC_PORTABLE` branches; their
active branch text is unchanged. The recipe always defines
`GKMS_PUBLIC_PORTABLE` and `GKMS_RUNTIME_COMMAND_BRIDGE`.

## Build prerequisites and commands

Use Windows x64, Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools with a Windows SDK, Python,
Conan **1.64.1** (the Conan 1 Premake generator is required), and
Premake **5.0.0-beta1** on PATH. Tools and package caches are not in this archive.
From a VS 2022 developer PowerShell in this extracted directory:

```powershell
python -m pip install conan==1.64.1
conan profile new default --detect
conan install . -if build -s os=Windows -s arch=x86_64 -s build_type=Release -s compiler="Visual Studio" -s compiler.version=17 -s compiler.runtime=MD --build=missing
premake5 vs2022
msbuild build/gkms_public_runtime_loader.vcxproj /m /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform=x64
```

Create the default Conan profile only if one does not already exist. Conan needs
access to its package remote or an existing compatible cache. Direct dependency
versions are pinned in `conanfile.txt`; transitive recipe revisions and toolchain
versions are not locked, so byte-identical reproduction is not asserted.
Fresh machine-local `build/conanbuildinfo.premake.lua` is generated by Conan.
The output is `build/bin/x64/Release/version.dll`. No install, game launch,
runtime patching, or deployment command is included.

This export was checked against the actual public project source inventory; a
fresh Conan dependency resolution and clean rebuild of this archive have not
been performed. The bridge and recorder implementations are separate source
components in the GKMS Assistant public repository (`native/runtime_command_bridge`,
`native/runtime_exam_recorder`, `native/shared`, and their build dependencies).
This loader archive alone is not the complete native control source distribution.

See `LICENSE` and `LICENSE-INVENTORY.json`. Upstream copyright and third-party
